verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents waterfall modeling that runs distribution scenarios across share classes and stakeholder groups. It also tracks liquidation preferences per share class and generates waterfall reports, and a community user confirms the waterfall analysis feature exists. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running the analysis at multiple different exit values, any evidence of participation handling, and evidence that preferences are applied inside the waterfall calculation itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run exit waterfall analyses showing proceeds per share class and stakeholder under different exit values, honoring preferences and participation

citations.quote: waterfall modeling lets leadership teams run detailed distribution scenarios across share classes and stakeholder groups
Track different share classes and their liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, and voting rights. Model complex cap-table scenarios and generate investor-ready cap-table and waterfall reports.
They called the financial modeling features (waterfall analysis and round modeling) 'really a cool feature.'
